name: How long does casement window replacement typically take for a home?

mainEntity.name: How long does casement window replacement typically take for a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of casement window replacement depends on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the installation. For an average-sized home, replacing all windows can typically take anywhere from a few days to a week. A single window replacement might be completed in less than a day. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific project during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement time varies; a few days to a week for an average home, depending on the number and complexity of windows.
